cells.gaps: No report, review or evaluation against the policy's targets has been found, and no adoption date beyond the text's publication on 2023-10-11. The implementation plan (ZMB-014) is given as 2022 to 2026, starting before the 2023 policy, with no costs; no budget line is tied to the policy. ZMB-012 repeats, in a plan dated 2026, the statement that a review of the National ICT Policy is under way (ZMB-010, August 2023), which predates the 2023 policy and is read as the review that produced it, not a new one.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2023: adopted, text public on the ministry's site and no end year, so stage 3. An open policy stops at stage 3, and no report against it has been found in any case.
